parameters.query:
-- One row per repo in config.yaml's one-line repos list (the poll's pattern).
-- The cursor is the newest merged_at taken in; on the first run it is an hour
-- ago, so the merge that shipped this workflow is watched too.
WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT body FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'config.yaml'
),
run AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.watch_runs (started) VALUES (now()) RETURNING id
),
repos AS (
  SELECT btrim(r, ' "''') AS repo
  FROM cfg, regexp_split_to_table((regexp_match(E'\n' || cfg.body, '\nrepos:\s*\[([^\]\n]*)\]'))[1], ',') AS r
),
cur AS (
  SELECT repos.repo, coalesce(c.merged_at, now() - interval '60 minutes') AS cursor, c.list_etag
  FROM repos LEFT JOIN triage.watch_cursor c ON c.repo = repos.repo
)
SELECT
  run.id AS run_id,
  cur.repo,
  cfg.body AS config_body,
  cur.cursor,
  cur.list_etag,
  -- Merges already watched, so a re-listed one isn't taken in twice.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(w.pr || '@' || w.merge_sha), '[]'::json) FROM triage.watches w
     WHERE w.repo = cur.repo AND w.merged_at >= cur.cursor - interval '1 day') AS known,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', w.id, 'repo', w.repo, 'pr', w.pr, 'merge_sha', w.merge_sha,
       'merged_at', w.merged_at, 'targets', w.targets, 'fail_streak', w.fail_streak, 'preexisting', w.preexisting) ORDER BY w.id), '[]'::json)
     FROM triage.watches w WHERE w.repo = cur.repo AND w.status = 'pending') AS pending,
  -- The last week's watches, for targets already failing before a merge.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', w.id, 'pr', w.pr, 'merge_sha', w.merge_sha, 'merged_at', w.merged_at,
       'status', w.status, 'failure_group', w.failure_group, 'detail', w.last_detail) ORDER BY w.merged_at, w.id), '[]'::json)
     FROM triage.watches w WHERE w.repo = cur.repo AND w.merged_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS history,
  -- Finished in the last day and not yet published: never planned, or planned
  -- under watch_write_mode labels with a write or the alert still to do.
  -- A shared failure's group is every watch with its failure_group; only the
  -- lowest id alerts for it.
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', w.id, 'repo', w.repo, 'pr', w.pr, 'merge_sha', w.merge_sha,
       'status', w.status, 'fix_forward', w.fix_forward, 'fix_forward_source', w.fix_forward_source,
       'detail', w.last_detail, 'alert_status', w.alert_status, 'alert_attempts', w.alert_attempts,
       'failure_group', w.failure_group, 'preexisting', w.preexisting,
       'group', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', g.id, 'pr', g.pr, 'merge_sha', g.merge_sha, 'fix_forward', g.fix_forward, 'preexisting', g.preexisting) ORDER BY g.id)
                 FROM triage.watches g WHERE g.repo = w.repo AND g.failure_group = w.failure_group)) ORDER BY w.id), '[]'::json)
     FROM triage.watches w
     WHERE w.repo = cur.repo AND w.status <> 'pending' AND w.finished_at > now() - interval '1 day'
       AND (w.planned_actions IS NULL
            OR (w.planned_actions ->> 'mode' = 'labels'
                AND (NOT w.published
                     OR (w.status <> 'ok' AND w.alert_attempts < 3
                         AND (w.alert_status IS NULL OR w.alert_status NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299)
                         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM triage.watches g
                                         WHERE g.repo = w.repo AND g.failure_group = w.failure_group AND g.id < w.id)))))) AS publishable,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(pattern ORDER BY pattern), '[]'::json) FROM triage.redaction_patterns) AS patterns,
  (SELECT body FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'github-app-id') AS app_id,
  (SELECT body FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'github-app-installation-id') AS installation_id
FROM run, cfg, cur;

nodes.name: List merges
nodes.notes: A 304 means no PR closed or changed since the last listing. Pages stop once updated_at is older than the cursor.

nodes.name: Work
nodes.notes: An idle run (no new merge, nothing pending or to publish) stops after this, having read only the listing.

nodes.name: Get merged PR
nodes.notes: merged_by, the body and the repo owner, which the list omits or the marker check needs.

nodes.name: Bot login
nodes.notes: The read-only token's own login: the bot. One of the identities that may write the fix-forward marker.

nodes.name: Cluster
nodes.notes: The unsaved sub-workflow holds the service-account token. It returns status and body only.

nodes.name: Watch
nodes.notes: Carries rules.js verbatim (sync-code-nodes.js). The only node that decides a watch's targets, status, fix-forward and writes.

nodes.name: Insert watch

parameters.query:
-- A merge with no target is ok at once (no rollout), and finished.
INSERT INTO triage.watches (repo, pr, merge_sha, merged_at, merged_by, targets, notes, status, fix_forward, fix_forward_source, last_detail, preexisting, checked_at, finished_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::timestamptz, NULLIF($5, ''), $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8, $9::boolean, NULLIF($10, ''), $11::jsonb, $12::jsonb, now(),
        CASE WHEN $8 <> 'pending' THEN now() END)
ON CONFLICT (repo, pr, merge_sha) DO NOTHING;

nodes.notes: merged_by is recorded here only, never published.

parameters.query:
-- Only a pending watch moves; a finished one keeps its result.
UPDATE triage.watches
SET status = $2, fail_streak = $3::jsonb, last_detail = $4::jsonb, checked_at = now(),
    finished_at = CASE WHEN $2 <> 'pending' THEN now() END, failure_group = NULLIF($5, ''),
    preexisting = $6::jsonb
WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending';

-- The plan and the mode it was made under. Under labels, a plan with nothing
-- to write means the PR already shows the result.
UPDATE triage.watches
SET planned_actions = $2::jsonb, publish_outcome = $3, run_id = $5,
    published = published OR ($4 = 'labels' AND $3 = 'up-to-date')
WHERE id = $1;

nodes.name: Write gate
nodes.notes: Only watch_write_mode labels (with write_mode labels) reaches the App. Ships off.

nodes.name: Alert gate
nodes.notes: Failed or timeout only, never ok, and only under watch_write_mode labels.

nodes.name: Alert
nodes.notes: The unsaved sub-workflow holds the webhook URL and posts only source, pr, status, fix_forward and checked.

parameters.query:
-- A 2xx ends the alerting for this watch; anything else is retried, at most
-- three tries in all.
UPDATE triage.watches
SET alerted_at = now(), alert_status = NULLIF($2::integer, 0), alert_attempts = alert_attempts + 1
WHERE id = $1;

-- Runs last (the lowest branch), or straight after Work on an idle run. ok
-- also needs every write this run planned to have read back as sent. The
-- cursor only moves forward, and only for a listing read in full.
WITH run AS (
  UPDATE triage.watch_runs
  SET finished = now(),
      ok = $2::boolean AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM triage.watches WHERE run_id = $1 AND publish_outcome IN ('failed', 'publishing')),
      new_merges = $3, checked = $4,
      published = (SELECT count(*) FROM triage.watches WHERE run_id = $1 AND publish_outcome = 'published')
  WHERE id = $1
  RETURNING ok
),
cur AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.watch_cursor (repo, merged_at, list_etag, updated_at)
  SELECT x.repo, x.cursor_next::timestamptz, NULLIF(x.etag_next, ''), now()
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($5::jsonb) AS x (repo text, cursor_next text, etag_next text, listed boolean)
  WHERE x.listed
  ON CONFLICT (repo) DO UPDATE
    SET merged_at = greatest(triage.watch_cursor.merged_at, excluded.merged_at), list_etag = excluded.list_etag, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING repo
)
SELECT (SELECT ok FROM run) AS ok, (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS cursors;
